name: 40K Robotic Grasp Demonstrations
summary: 包含约四万条自然场景六自由度机器人抓取示范的数据集，记录视觉观测、末端位姿和抓取结果，用于学习从视觉到动作的操作策略。
summaryEn: A dataset of roughly 40,000 naturalistic 6-DoF robotic grasp demonstrations with visual observations, end-effector poses, and grasp outcomes.
